title: Start-to-finish: BF16 uncensored -> Unsloth UD-IQ4_XS on 3x RTX 3090
objective: Download orcarouter/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored (BF16), convert to Q8_0 master, imatrix on 3x3090, apply Unsloth UD-IQ4_XS map, bake template, split 2G, verify.
agent_rules: Execute steps in order. Skip if skip_if is true.
Do not reuse an FP8-derived Q8 master. Convert this BF16 tree.
Convert BF16 straight to Q8_0. Do not write a 350GB BF16 GGUF.
On 401/403 stop and accept the gate URLs then hf auth login.
On convert CUDA OOM retry CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0.
Do not delete BF16 or Q8 master until verify succeeds.

steps.name: clone_playbook
steps.cmd: git clone https://github.com/groxaxo/qwen38-flash-next-sharp-chat-template work-playbook && cp work-playbook/quantize_orcarouter_fp8.sh work-playbook/extract_gguf_tensor_map.py work-playbook/chat_template.jinja . && chmod +x quantize_orcarouter_fp8.sh extract_gguf_tensor_map.py

steps.name: build_llamacpp_cuda
steps.cmd: git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp llama.cpp && cmake -S llama.cpp -B llama.cpp/build -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build llama.cpp/build -j --target llama-quantize llama-imatrix llama-gguf-split llama-cli llama-server gguf-new-metadata

steps.name: pip_deps
steps.cmd: python3 -m pip install -U 'huggingface_hub[hf_transfer]' hf_transfer sentencepiece transformers torch gguf numpy

steps.name: calib
steps.cmd: mkdir -p calib && curl -L --fail -o calib/wiki.train.raw https://huggingface.co/datasets/wikitext/resolve/main/wikitext-2-raw-v1/wiki.train.raw && head -c 8000000 calib/wiki.train.raw > calib/calib.txt

steps.name: convert_bf16_to_q8
steps.cmd: mkdir -p out && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2 CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True,max_split_size_mb:512 python3 ./llama.cpp/convert_hf_to_gguf.py ./hf-src-bf16 --outfile ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-BF16-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.master.q8_0.gguf --outtype q8_0

steps.name: quantize_udiq4xs
steps.cmd: SKIP_CONVERT=1 SRC=./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-BF16-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.master.q8_0.gguf RECIPE=unsloth QUANT=UD-IQ4_XS MAP=./maps/UD-IQ4_XS.tensor-types IMATRIX=./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-BF16-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.imatrix.gguf RECOMPUTE_IMATRIX=0 LLAMA_CPP=./llama.cpp OUT=./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-BF16-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS ./quantize_orcarouter_fp8.sh

steps.name: verify
steps.cmd: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2 ./llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-cli -m ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-BF16-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS-00001-of-*.gguf --jinja --chat-template-file ./chat_template.jinja --reasoning-format deepseek -ngl 99 -sm layer -ts 1,1,1 --override-tensor per_layer_token_embd=CPU -fit off -c 4096 -n 64 -p 'Reply with the single word: pong' --temp 0

serve_after: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2 ./llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-server -m ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-BF16-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS-00001-of-*.gguf --mmproj mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored-F16.gguf --jinja --chat-template-file ./chat_template.jinja --reasoning-format deepseek -ngl 99 -sm layer -ts 1,1,1 --override-tensor per_layer_token_embd=CPU -fit off -c 32768 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --flash-attn on -t 12 -tb 20
